description: This file defines a command handler class for removing a savings officer from a savings account within the Apache Fineract project. It registers as a service and handles the 'REMOVESAVINGSOFFICER' command, delegating the action to the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService.

classes.name: RemoveSavingsOfficerCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service component that handles the removal of a savings officer from an account, implementing the command pattern.

methods.name: RemoveSavingsOfficerCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the SavingsAccountWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the 'REMOVE SAVINGS OFFICER' command by delegating to the savings write platform service.
